Row.Text: Newly founded [icon:YIELD_TOWNS] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TOWN_TOOLTIP]Towns[/TIP] in [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_DISTANT_LANDS_TOOLTIP]Distant Lands[/TIP] start with this [icon:NAR_REW_RELIGION] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP] in place.

+2 [icon:Action_Move] Movement for [icon:UNIT_MISSIONARY] Missionaries when [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_EMBARK_TOOLTIP]Embarked[/TIP]. +1 [icon:Action_Move] Movement for all [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_NAVAL_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Naval[/TIP] and [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_EMBARK_TOOLTIP]Embarked[/TIP] Units.

+5 [icon:NAR_REW_COMBAT] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_COMBAT_STRENGTH_TOOLTIP]Combat Strength[/TIP] for [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MILITARY_UNIT_TOOLTIP]Military Units[/TIP] in friendly [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] that follow this [icon:NAR_REW_RELIGION] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP].

When a [icon:TRADE_ROUTE] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TRADE_ROUTE_TOOLTIP]Trade Route[/TIP] is established to a [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP], it is converted to your [icon:NAR_REW_RELIGION] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP].
+10% [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production towards training [icon:UNIT_MISSIONARY] Missionaries for every [icon:NAR_REW_GREATWORK] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIC_TOOLTIP]Relic[/TIP].
Gain 2 [icon:UNIT_MISSIONARY] Missionaries when you build a [icon:WONDER] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_WONDERS_TOOLTIP]Wonder[/TIP]. This belief can be chosen by multiple Civilizations.

+1 [icon:WAR_SUPPORT] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_WAR_SUPPORT_TOOLTIP]War Support[/TIP] against Civilizations who have founded a [icon:NAR_REW_RELIGION] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP].

[icon:UNIT_TREASURE_FLEET] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TREASURE_CONVOY_TOOLTIP]Treasure Convoys[/TIP] gain +1 [icon:Action_Move] Movement and +5 [icon:NAR_REW_COMBAT] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_COMBAT_STRENGTH_TOOLTIP]Combat Strength[/TIP] when defending.
+2 [icon:NAR_REW_GREATWORK] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIC_TOOLTIP]Relics[/TIP] for first-time conversion of a [icon:CITYSTATE] City-State.
+2 [icon:NAR_REW_GREATWORK] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIC_TOOLTIP]Relics[/TIP] for first-time conversion of another Civilization’s [icon:NOTIFICATION_SELECT_CAPITAL] Capital City.

+1 [icon:NAR_REW_GREATWORK] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIC_TOOLTIP]Relic[/TIP] for first-time conversion of another Civilization’s [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] with a Temple or Altar.

+2 [icon:NAR_REW_GREATWORK] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIC_TOOLTIP]Relics[/TIP] for first-time conversion of another Civilization’s [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] with a [icon:WONDER] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_WONDERS_TOOLTIP]Wonder[/TIP] from any [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_AGE_TOOLTIP]Age[/TIP].

+1 [icon:NAR_REW_GREATWORK] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIC_TOOLTIP]Relic[/TIP] for first-time conversion of another Civilization’s [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] in [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_DISTANT_LANDS_TOOLTIP]Distant Lands[/TIP] that is not a City-State.

+2 [icon:NAR_REW_GREATWORK] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIC_TOOLTIP]Relics[/TIP] for first-time conversion of another Civilization’s [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] producing [icon:UNIT_TREASURE_FLEET] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TREASURE_CONVOY_TOOLTIP]Treasure Convoys[/TIP].

+1 [icon:NAR_REW_GREATWORK] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIC_TOOLTIP]Relic[/TIP] for first-time conversion of another Civilization’s [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] with at least 10 [icon:YIELD_POPULATION] Rural Population.

+1 [icon:NAR_REW_GREATWORK] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIC_TOOLTIP]Relic[/TIP] for first-time conversion of another Civilization’s [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] with at least 10 [icon:YIELD_POPULATION] Urban Population.
+2 [icon:NAR_REW_GREATWORK] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIC_TOOLTIP]Relics[/TIP] for the first-time conversion of a [icon:YIELD_CITIES] Holy City. This belief can be chosen by multiple Civilizations.
+1 [icon:NAR_REW_GREATWORK] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIC_TOOLTIP]Relic[/TIP] for first-time conversion of one of your [icon:YIELD_CITIES] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CITIES_TOOLTIP]Cities[/TIP].

+2 [icon:NAR_REW_GREATWORK] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIC_TOOLTIP]Relics[/TIP] for first-time conversion of a [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] with at least 3 [icon:SPECIALIST] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SPECIALIST_TOOLTIP]Specialists[/TIP].

+2 [icon:NAR_REW_GREATWORK] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIC_TOOLTIP]Relics[/TIP] for first-time conversion of any [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] with a [icon:NOTIFICATION_DISCOVER_NATURAL_WONDER] Natural Wonder.

+4 [icon:YIELD_SCIENCE] Science for every foreign [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] following your [icon:NAR_REW_RELIGION] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP]. +1 [icon:YIELD_SCIENCE] Science for each of your own [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] following your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP].

+8 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture, [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold, and [icon:YIELD_SCIENCE] Science for every terrain that has a [icon:NOTIFICATION_DISCOVER_NATURAL_WONDER] Natural Wonder in other Civilizations’ [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] following your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP].

+4 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture, [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold, and [icon:YIELD_SCIENCE] Science for every [icon:WONDER] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_WONDERS_TOOLTIP]Wonder[/TIP] in other Civilizations’ [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] following your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP].

+4 [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold for every foreign [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] following your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP]. +1 [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold for each of your own [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] following your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP].

+4 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture for every foreign [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] following your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP]. +1 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture for each of your own [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] following your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP].

+2 [icon:YIELD_SCIENCE] Science for every Tropical biome in other Civilizations’ [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] following your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP].

+2 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture for every Tundra biome in other Civilizations’ [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] following your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP].

+2 [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold for every Desert biome in other Civilizations’ [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] following your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP].

+4 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness for every foreign [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] following your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP]. +1 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness for each of your own [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] following your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP].

+1 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness for every Marine biome in other Civilizations’ [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] following your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP].

+1 [icon:YIELD_SCIENCE] Science for every Grassland biome in other Civilizations' [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] following your [icon:NAR_REW_RELIGION] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP].

+1 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture for every Plains biome in other Civilizations' [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] following your [icon:NAR_REW_RELIGION] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP].

+3 [icon:YIELD_SCIENCE] Science, [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture, [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness, [icon:YIELD_DIPLOMACY] Influence, and [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold on the Temple in your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_HOLY_CITY_TOOLTIP]Holy City[/TIP]. If you retain this belief, this bonus transfers to your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PALACE_TOOLTIP]Palace[/TIP] in [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MODERN_AGE_TOOLTIP]Modern Age[/TIP]. This belief can be chosen by multiple Civilizations.

+2 [icon:YIELD_DIPLOMACY] Influence for every foreign [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] following your [icon:NAR_REW_RELIGION] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP]. +1 [icon:YIELD_DIPLOMACY] Influence for each of your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] following your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP].

+1 [icon:YIELD_DIPLOMACY] Influence for every [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_NAVIGABLE_RIVER_TOOLTIP]Navigable River[/TIP] terrain in foreign [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] following your [icon:NAR_REW_RELIGION] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELIGION_TOOLTIP]Religion[/TIP].
All [icon:CITY_BUILDING_LIST] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_BUILDINGS_TOOLTIP]Buildings[/TIP] receive a +1 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness adjacency with the Temple.
Have the [B]Shrines of the Kami [/B] Belief
